verses.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.sm: Iafeta 10 ‚O gafa foi nei o atalii o Noa, o Semu, o Hamo, ma lafeta; na fananau foi ia te i latouo atalii a ua mavae le lolo.

verses.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.sm: O atalii nei o Iafeta; o Komeri, ma Makoku, ma Metai, ma Iavana, ma Tupalu, ma Meseko, ma Tirasi.

verses.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.sm: O atalii foi neio Komeri; o Asekeneso, ma Rifata, ma Tokaremo.

verses.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.sm: O atalii foi nei o lavana; o Elisa, ma Tasesa, o Kitimo, ma Totanimo;

verses.en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.sm: o i latou nei na aina solo ai o nuu tumatafaga o nuu ese, i o latou laueleele, e taitoatasi ma lana gagana, i o latou aiga, i o latou nuu.

verses.en: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Hamo; o Kuso, ma Misaraimo, ma Futu, ma Kanana.

verses.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Kuso; o Sepa, ma Havila, ma Sapeta, ma Ragama, ma Sapeteka; o atalii foi o Ragama; o Seepa, ma Titana.

verses.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Kuso o Nimarota; o ia foi na amata ona fai ma alii malosi i le lalolagi;

verses.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
verses.sm: o lē malosi foi o ia i tuli manu i luma o le ALII; o le mea lea ua faapea ai le upu, E pei o Nimarota lē malosi i tuli manu i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.sm: to O le pogai foi o lona malo o Papelu, ma Areka, ma Akata, ma Kalene, i le nuu o Senara.

verses.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.sm: O le nuu lava lea na alu atu ai Asura, ma ia faia Nineva, ma le aai o Reopo, ma Kala,

verses.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
verses.sm: ma Resena e i le va o Nineva ma Kala; o le aai tele lea.

verses.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Misaraimo o tagata Luti, ma tagata Anama, ma tagata Leapi, ma tagata Nafatui,

verses.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.sm: ma tagata Pateruse, ma tagata Kaselui, (sa tutupu ai Filisitia,) ma tagata Kafatori.

verses.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Kanana o Saitonu, o lana ulumatua lea, ma Heti,

verses.en: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.sm: ma sa lepusé, ma sa Amori, ma sa Kirekasé,

verses.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.sm: ma sa Hivi, ma sa Areki, ma sa Seni,

verses.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.sm: ma sa Arati, ma sa Semari, ma sa Hamato; mulimuli ane ua faasalalau atu aiga o sa Kanana.

verses.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.sm: O le tuaoi foi o sa Kanana na afua lea i Saitonu, ona oo lea i Kasa, i le ala e ui atu ai i Kira; ona ui lea i Sotoma, ma Komoro, ma Atama, ma Sepoima, e oo atu i Lasa.

verses.en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
verses.sm: O atalii ia o Hamo i o latou aiga, ma a latou gagana, i o latou laueleele, ma o latou nuu.

verses.en: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
verses.sm: O Semu foi na fanaua ona atalii, o le tupuga o le fanau uma a Eperu, o le uso o Iafeta le matua.

verses.en: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.sm: O atalii nei o Semu; o Elama, ma Asura, ma Afasata, ma Luti, ma Arama.

verses.en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.sm: O atalii foi nei o Arama; o Usa, ma Hulo, ma Kiteru, ma Mase.

verses.en: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Afasata, o Selaa; na fanaua foi e Selaa, o Eperu.

verses.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Eperu ona aiaW e toalua; o le igoa o le tasi o Peleko; auá o ona aso ia ua vaevaeina ai le lalolagi; o le igoa foi o lona uso e Ioketana.

verses.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Ioketana o Alemotata, ma Salefo, ma Asamoveta, ma laraa,

verses.en: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.sm: ma Aturamo, ma Usala, ma Tikelu,

verses.en: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.sm: o Upalu foi, ma Apimalu, ma Seepa,

verses.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.sm: ma Ofeira, ma Havila, ma Iopapo; o i latou uma nei o atalii o Ioketana.

verses.en: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.sm: O le mea na latou mau ai na afua i Mesa ua oo i Sefara, o le mauga lea i sasae,

verses.en: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.sm: O atalii ia o Semu, i o latou aiga, ma a latou gagana, i o latou laueleele, i o latou nuu.

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.sm: O aiga ia o atalii o Noa, e tusa ma o latou gafa i o latou nuu; o i latou ia foi na áina solo ai atunuu i le lalolagi ina ua mavae o le lolo. Ua faia
